youtube.title: Why Jar Lids Have a Little Pop-Up Button 🫙 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The round button in the middle of many jar lids is a safety indicator. Jars of jam, sauce or baby food are sealed hot, and as they cool a vacuum forms inside that pulls the button down flat. If the seal is ever broken, air gets in and the button pops up and clicks when pressed. So if a jar's lid clicks before you open it, the seal has failed and the food may not be safe.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.

#Shorts #science #facts #thehiddenwhy

sources: Food safety guidance (USDA/FSIS): a lid that flexes or pops up means the vacuum seal is broken
